persistentPythonForwardingRegression.beforeFix: The installed Linux CI receipt for source 1a5b4fb used selected Python 3.12.16 for portable creation but fallback Python 3.14.4 for managed tmux creation. The extension provided the choice only in supervisor environment, which was scrubbed; no env-file captured it.
persistentPythonForwardingRegression.afterFix: The extension supplies a literal --python argument. New supervisor configuration captures that validated override (CLI over env-file) or its absence, and _run forwards the captured value to the daemon. Live-session attachment does not rewrite configuration. Legacy records without the new field retain env-file behavior.
persistentPythonForwardingRegression.localProof: The actual supervisor CLI, private configuration and daemon child execute under Node and VS Code Electron with a local tmux simulator. Tests cover spaces/quotes, precedence, absence of override, env-file changes, legacy records, rejected ambient settings and unchanged existing-session configuration.
